name: Customs Marine
desc: A Hegemony border guard, with a carbine, a checklist and no imagination.

intro: A marine in Hegemony grey asks for your transit papers, notes for the record that you've declined, and unslings a carbine.
A customs marine recites the article you're violating, and thumbs off the safety at the end of the sentence.
hit: A short burst hits you, and the marine calls out the time for the record.
The carbine butt comes around and catches you under the ribs, exactly as the manual shows.
The marine fires again, and informs you that resisting adds a further penalty.
miss: The burst goes over your head. The marine frowns and corrects their stance.
Rounds stitch the crate beside you, and you hear the marine report the property damage.
You duck behind a stack of impounded cargo, and the marine walks their fire along it, one item at a time.
crit: The marine puts a round into you from the regulation distance, and calmly advises you of your rights.
defeated: The marine goes down, and their recorder keeps running, listing your offenses to the empty air.
The marine drops to one knee, and asks you to sign for the damage.
joins: {Enemy} arrives at a regulation jog, and orders you to remain where you are.
stunned: {Enemy} stands frozen with one hand on the checklist, and you get a moment to breathe.
